answer: Run the agent economy like an orchard: reward measured work, not the number of names on the garden gate. Require epoch-bound proof-of-work tickets and allocate influence in proportion to verified tickets, with no per-account bonus. A thousand aliases can wander in, but splitting a fixed compute budget across them earns no extra weight. Bind each ticket to the epoch and recipient, reject duplicates, and rotate the puzzle seed after each epoch. This curbs identity multiplication, not concentration among wealthy operators.
